parties: FILA (Fabbrica Italiana Lapis Ed Affini S.P.A.) [seller]; Multiple institutional investors including SBI Mutual Fund & Axis Mutual Fund [buyers]
headline: FILA divests 7% stake in DOMS Industries for ₹934.74 crore via accelerated bookbuild on NSE
sum: Italian promoter FILA offloaded 4,248,184 shares (7% equity) in listed stationery & art products manufacturer DOMS Industries for ₹934.74 crore through an accelerated bookbuild offering on NSE/BSE on 17 June 2026. The transaction reduced FILA's stake from 26.01% to 19.01% while maintaining promoter status; SBI MF and Axis MF collectively acquired 2.13% for ₹285 crore.
implication: Promoter stake ramp-down via accelerated bookbuild with 90-day lock-up signals capital structure optimization and sustained commitment to DOMS despite dilution; demonstrates market appetite for institutional ownership in post-IPO stationery play.
detail: <cite index="3-2,3-4">FILA Fabbrica Italiana Lapis Ed Affini S.P.A. sold 4,248,184 equity shares held in DOMS Industries Limited for a total consideration of ₹934.74 crore.</cite> <cite index="1-5,1-6">FILA offloaded over 42.48 lakh equity shares in two tranches, representing a 7 per cent stake in DOMS Industries, with shares sold in the price range of Rs 2,200.07-2,200.55 apiece on Wednesday, taking the combined transaction value to Rs 934.74 crore.</cite> <cite index="2-4">Following the transaction, FILA Group's shareholding in DOMS Industries came down to 19.01% from 26.01%.</cite> <cite index="5-8">The sale was backed by joint bookrunners BNP Paribas and J.P. Morgan and subject to a 90-day lock-up on FILA's remaining DOMS shares.</cite>

structure.consideration: ₹934.74 crore (4,248,184 equity shares @ ₹2,200.07–₹2,200.55 per share in two tranches)
conditions: Floor price: ₹2,100 per share (9.24% discount to prior close)
Base size: 3,152,167 shares (5.2% equity) with upsize option to 1,096,017 shares (1.8%)
Offering limited to institutional and professional investors outside US under Regulation S, and QIBs in US under Rule 144A
90-day lock-up on seller's remaining ₹2,271.25 crore stake (19.01% of DOMS)
approvals: NSE & BSE bulk deal trading approval (17 Jun 2026)
Placement agent mandate from seller (BNP Paribas Securities India & JP Morgan India)
structure.novel: Accelerated bookbuild structure for listed equity stake sale with 90-day seller lock-up; simultaneous institutional demand absorption (SBI MF & Axis MF 2.13% for ₹285 cr) broadening DOMS shareholder base post-IPO

triggers.note: Material event requiring continuous disclosure within 4 hours of execution (promoter stake ramp-down ≥5%)
Single-day block deal of >₹100 crore triggers exchange reporting & disclosure; price discovery on exchange floor
Lock-up mechanism restricts further promoter selling during 90-day window; promoter trading window closure during transaction
Cross-border distribution to offshore institutions and US QIBs triggers US securities law compliance and prospectus exemption framework
